column1: # Scenario table for tools/trace/run_trace.py (TAB separated; '#' starts a comment line).
# name        : scenario id; input script = traces/inputs/<name>.macro (source) and <name>.txt (resolved frames, replayed by default)
# mobile      : off | on | at:<frame>  (Mobile Adapter GB emulated by libmobile on the link port; at:N = hot-plug at frame N)
# net         : stub (adapter sockets refused) | fake (built-in fake Internet: DNS/POP3/SMTP/HTTP) | real (host network; NOT reproducible)
# from        : scenario whose final SRAM (.sav) and adapter config (.cfg) this one starts from, or '-' for a factory-fresh
#               cartridge (SRAM filled with 0xFF) and a blank adapter
# web         : 1 = serve traces/web/*.html (Shift-JIS converted) from the fake HTTP server
# extra (optional 7th column, space separated): `lite` = publish only coverage/mbc_writes + small detail files (dataaccess, ramcode, serialsum, irqsum,
#               stats, marks, adapter.log; no serial/callgraph/hwregs/mbc_seq/irq), or raw harness args such as `--sram-fill 00`, `--sram-poke 0:A000=12`, `--cfg-poke 2=00`
# net accepts `:key=value,...` after the mode (fake-Internet options of mgba_trace.c, e.g. `fake:latency=2,pop_fail=pass`); the key `mail=a+b` selects traces/net/mail_a.eml ... for the POP3 mailbox
# web accepts `all` = every traces/web file served under its own name
